Language Movement veteran Nafisa Kabir no more
2022-02-07T20:16:48+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/language-movement-veteran-nafisa-kabir-no-more-2956591

Nafisa Kabir, sister of martyred journalist and intellectual Shahidullah Kaiser and renowned writer and filmmaker Zahir Raihan, died today of pneumonia at a hospital in St Louis, USA, aged around 90.

The eldest daughter of the late Maulana Habib Ullah, former principal of Madrasa-e-Alia, Nafisa Kabir was the second of five brothers and three sisters.

A very meritorious and talented student, she won a gold medal from the then Feni Sub-Division Amirabad High School by securing the first place in the combined merit list.

As a student, Kabir was active in politics as a communist party activist alongside her brothers and was also deeply involved in the Language Movement of 1952.

Nafisa Kabir worked tirelessly for the development of humanity, gender equality, good governance and democracy.

She left behind four daughters, one son and many relatives, friends and admirers to mourn her demise.
